caption_L1: Here a is a bar plot called Do you use a tablet for any of the following ?. The x-axis measures activities children carried out on tablets with categorical scale with Browsing online on one end and Watching videos at the other while the y-axis shows 8-12 as linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8.
caption_L2L3: Children usually use tablets for playing games, to learn things, watching videos, downloading apps and browsing online. Children rarely use tablets for taking pictures or films, video chat, watching TV, chatting with friends, and social networking.
